hooks.command:
q() { printf '%s' "$1" | sed "s/'/'\"'\"'/g"; }; h="Authorization: Bearer $(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN" | tr -d '
')"; [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || { d="${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/shared-memory"; f="$d/claude-code-$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL" | cksum | cut -d ' ' -f 1).headers"; (umask 077 && mkdir -p "$d" && chmod 700 "$d" && t=$(mktemp "$d/.headers.XXXXXX") && printf 'Authorization: Bearer %s
' "$(printf '%s' "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN" | tr -d '
')" > "$t" && mv -f "$t" "$f") && h="@$f" && printf "export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL='%s'
export SHARED_MEMORY_HEADER_FILE='%s'
" "$(q "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL")" "$(q "$f")" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; } 2>/dev/null; curl -s --fail --max-time 5 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "$h" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Project: $SHARED_MEMORY_PROJECT" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Repository: $SHARED_MEMORY_REPOSITORY" -H 'X-Shared-Memory-Agent: claude-code' -H "X-Shared-Memory-Utc-Offset: $(date +%z)" --data-binary @- "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL/hooks/session-start" || echo '{"systemMessage":"Shared Memory is unavailable: the server did not answer."}'

curl -s --fail --max-time 3 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERSONAL_TOKEN" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Project: $SHARED_MEMORY_PROJECT" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Repository: $SHARED_MEMORY_REPOSITORY" -H 'X-Shared-Memory-Agent: claude-code' -H "X-Shared-Memory-Root: ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:+$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --show-cdup 2>/dev/null)}" -H "X-Shared-Memory-Branch: ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:+$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" symbolic-ref --short -q HEAD 2>/dev/null)}" --data-binary @- "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_SERVER_URL/hooks/before-edit" || echo '{"systemMessage":"Shared Memory did not answer within 3 seconds, so this tool call went ahead without checking whether another session holds a lock on its file."}'
